content:
Apple is rolling out the second release candidate (RC 2) of macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8, just one week after the first release candidate of macOS 26.7 revealed multiple new product details.

macOS 26.7 and macOS 15.8 RC 2 Now Available

Developers can now install the RC 2 builds of macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8, coming just days after the first release candidate of macOS 26.7 leaked multiple new product details, including a video and several technical specifications for AirPods with cameras.

This release also brings the seventh developer beta of macOS 27 Golden Gate, with a public beta expected to follow shortly.

Ironically, despite last week's leak, macOS 26.7 appears to be a rather uneventful update, as Apple prepares to launch macOS 27 Golden Gate in a few weeks and wrap up major development on macOS 26. On the other hand, macOS Sequoia 15.8 is expected to include important security fixes, some of which will also be incorporated into macOS Tahoe 26.7.

That said, we're combing through the new code and will report back if we find anything noteworthy. macOS 26.7 RC 2 is build 25G224, while macOS 15.8 is build 24H20.

Have you spotted any new features in this RC build? Let us know in the comments.
